title: Music for the RPG in Development

blocks.source: 制作中のRPGに使用する曲
blocks.translation: Music for the RPG in Development

blocks.source: 制作中のRPGに使用する曲を紹介してみます。
blocks.translation: Let me introduce some music for the RPG I am currently developing.

blocks.source: といっても、僕は義務教育レベルの音楽教育しか、受けていません。
blocks.translation: That said, my music education only extends to the level provided by compulsory education.

blocks.source: 古くはマリオペイントやデザエモンといったSFCのゲームソフトの付属機能で簡単な作曲をしていた経験がありますが、まともに作曲を始めたのは2006年頃で、ゲーム制作のためだけに片手間でやり始めました。とまあ、そんな程度の経験しかないのですが、やってみれば意外とできるものです。大量に没曲も出しましたが、半分程度は聞くに耐えうるできになったと自負しています。
blocks.translation: I have some experience composing simple music using the built-in features of SFC games such as Mario Paint and Dezaemon, but I did not seriously begin composing until around 2006, when I started doing it on the side solely for game development. So, although that is the extent of my experience, it is surprisingly doable once you try. I produced a large number of scrapped tracks, but I am proud to say that about half of them turned out listenable.

blocks.source: この経験を活かして作曲講座でも将来的に作りたいところ。
blocks.translation: I would like to use this experience to create a music composition guide someday.

blocks.source: 通常戦闘曲です。通常戦闘曲と言えば、もっとも良く聞く曲であり、飽きないように作曲しなければならないとは、すぎやまこういち先生を始めとした多数のゲーム音楽家も述べていることです。
blocks.translation: This is the normal battle theme. Many game composers, including Koichi Sugiyama, have said that since the normal battle theme is the track players hear most often, it must be composed so that it does not become tiresome.

blocks.source: この曲は地味に始まりながらも、途中に意外なピアノを挟み、そこから壮大っぽいストリングスに繋げて締めることで、比較的、飽きにくいようにできたと思っています。
blocks.translation: Although this track begins modestly, it inserts an unexpected piano passage midway through, then transitions into grand-sounding strings for the finale, so I think I managed to make it relatively difficult to get tired of.

blocks.source: ザコ敵相手に思わぬ苦戦を強いられて長期戦になった頃には、曲の雰囲気も変わっているという流れになれば、理想的ですよね。
blocks.translation: Ideally, by the time you are forced into an unexpectedly difficult, prolonged battle against weak enemies, the mood of the music would have changed as well.

blocks.source: フィールド曲。同じく何度も聞く曲です。少し寂しい感じがしたので、最初は気に入ってなかったのですが、これはこれで良いような気がしてきましたので、採用となりました。
blocks.translation: This is the field theme. It is another track you hear repeatedly. I initially did not like it because it felt a little lonely, but I came to feel that it had its own merits, so I decided to use it.

blocks.source: 村の曲です。のどかな村というよりは寂れた村という印象です。
blocks.translation: This is the village theme. Rather than a peaceful village, it gives the impression of a run-down one.

blocks.source: 拾ってきたフルートのサウンドフォントがいい音を出してくれます。
blocks.translation: The SoundFont for the flute that I found produces a lovely sound.

blocks.source: もっといい曲もあるのですが、この時点で曲だけ公開するのは微妙というもの。
blocks.translation: I have some even better tracks, but releasing only the music at this point would feel a little underwhelming.

blocks.source: 残りは作品公開に至ってからのお楽しみということで。
blocks.translation: I will leave the rest for you to look forward to once the game is released.

blocks.source: でも、作品中では容量やループ処理の問題もあって、MP3で鳴らす曲は一部だけになるかと思います・・・
blocks.translation: However, due to issues such as file size and loop processing, I expect that only some of the tracks in the game will be played as MP3s...
